prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: In her history of the city, one scholar described its relief program of the 1890s as above all ______.

worlds.passage: In 1893, during a deep economic slump, a mid-sized industrial city began giving aid to families out of work. Its clerk designed the program alone, ignoring the charity methods then popular elsewhere, and it ran unchanged for thirty years; a family applied on a single short form and received only enough flour and coal for a week, while the city spent a tenth of what neighboring cities did per family. In her history of the city, one scholar described its relief program of the 1890s as above all ______.
worlds.explanation: Families got only a week's flour and coal, and the city spent a tenth of what its neighbors did, so the program was "frugal." "Cumbersome" fails because applying took a single short form. "Fashionable" fails because the clerk ignored the methods popular elsewhere. "Experimental" fails because it ran unchanged for thirty years.

fashionable.quote: ignoring the charity methods then popular elsewhere
fashionable.why: The program did not follow the trend of its day.

experimental.why: A program fixed for decades was not a trial.
